title: Hyundai Canada - Frequently Asked Questions (NACS and Supercharger access)
notes: Read directly: IONIQ 5 and IONIQ 9 from the 2026 model year have a NACS port; other EVs with a CCS port, 'such as the 2026 KONA Electric', and Hyundai EVs of model year 2025 and earlier, can use a NACS adapter 'available separately'. Hyundai Canada EV hub (https://www.hyundaicanada.com/en/evhub/electric-vehicles) adds a free CCS-to-NACS adapter offer for native-CCS Hyundai EVs until 2026-12-31 or while supplies last (Bluelink enrolment and EV Special Care service; eligible models not listed there).
